column1: DAB's default JSON configuration filename is {{c1::dab-config.json}}.
column2:
The CLI can use a different file through its --config option.
Review source

column1: DAB stores its database type and connection string in the {{c1::data-source}} section.
column2:
For SQL Server and Azure SQL Database, use database-type mssql.
Review source

column1: Global endpoint, host, and cache settings belong in DAB's {{c1::runtime}} section.
column2:
These settings control how the API server behaves.
Review source

column1: Reference the environment variable DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING in a DAB string value with {{c1::@env('DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING')}}.
column2:
DAB substitutes the value when it loads configuration, so the JSON need not contain the credential itself.
Review source

column1: Configure DAB's GraphQL endpoint path with {{c1::runtime.graphql.path}}.
column2:
The default endpoint is /graphql, which receives GraphQL queries.
Review source

column1: DAB's {{c1::runtime.host.cors.allow-credentials}} setting controls the Access-Control-Allow-Credentials response header.
column2:
This browser policy setting does not authenticate a caller.
Review source

column1: Create a baseline DAB configuration for SQL Server with {{c1::dab init --database-type mssql}}.
column2:
Supply a connection string through an @env() reference rather than a literal secret.
Review source

column1: Add a new entity to an existing DAB configuration with {{c1::dab add}}, followed by its name, source, and permissions.
column2:
Example: dab add Product --source dbo.Products --permissions "anonymous:read"
Review source

column1: Start DAB using a complete dab-config.production.json file with {{c1::dab start --config dab-config.production.json}}.
column2:
The --config option selects a specific file. For environment overrides, use the documented DAB_ENVIRONMENT workflow.
Review source

column1: Select DAB's named configuration environment with the {{c1::DAB_ENVIRONMENT}} environment variable.
column2:
For example, Production selects the dab-config.Production.json variant alongside the base configuration.
Review source
